subject: Evidence packet request: key locality, HSM ops, and VPC peering
messages:
From: Aisling Murphy <aisling@terrahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: security+redwood@terrahealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: proof of key locality + operator manifest for EU deployment

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the call earlier. TerraHealth's security review has a couple of tightly scoped asks before we move the pilot into an EU-only production slice:

1) Cryptographic key locality: an affirmation that customer master keys used for production workloads serving EU data are stored in HSMs physically located in the EU and are not replicated outside the EU. We don't need the internal key material, just architecture + exported audit excerpts showing HSM region binding and operator access controls.

2) Operator manifest: a short roster of people/accounts who have keystore / HSM operator privilege for the EU tenancy, with role titles and whether they are Redwood employees or third-party operators.

3) Network boundary: evidence that private endpoints for the EU hosting plane terminate into TerraHealth's VPC peer (privatelink) and a short diagram of egress conditioning (ie what goes to public internet vs stays inside the peering).

Can you point us to a single packet (one zip or Drive folder) with the artifacts? We have a tight security window and would like to close this by Friday (5/23). If you can call out any SOC 2 / CAIQ artifacts that map directly to these asks that would help us accelerate review.

Thanks,
Aisling
Aisling Murphy
Security Engineer, TerraHealth
aisling@terrahealth.com

---
Attachment: questions-list.txt (text)

Hi Aisling — thanks, and great to chat. We've started assembling a focused evidence packet and can deliver the items below by end of day Thursday (5/22):

- Residency-Evidence-Summary.pdf: short narrative + architecture diagram showing HSM cluster placement (EU zones only) and key handling flow.
- operator-roster.csv: export of operator accounts with role, employment type (employee/contractor/partner), and last access date.
- soc2-exhibit3.pdf: redacted SOC 2 artifact that maps to key-management controls (we'll redact PII).
- caiq-responses.xlsx: CAIQ answers that point to network and crypto control families.

Quick answers inline to your numbered asks:
1) Key locality: production KMS/HSM are provisioned in eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 (region-specific HSM clusters). We do not replicate customer CMKs to regions outside the EU for EU-only tenants by policy and runtime configuration. We'll include audit export slices showing HSM instance IDs and region tags.
2) Operator manifest: we'll include the roster CSV and a brief runbook excerpt showing how operator escalations are gated (MFA, Just-in-Time privilege elevation, change approvals).
3) Network boundary: a concise topology diagram and our peering confirmation (privatelink connection id + peer subnet ranges).

If you have a preferred place to drop the packet, let us know; otherwise I'll share a Drive folder and a DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum.

Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance (Customer Trust)
Redwood Inference

Hi all — packet is mostly assembled. Delivery plan below: 

1) Shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-residency-evidence (read-only link) — contains Residency-Evidence-Summary.pdf, operator-roster.csv (redacted email addresses), and topology diagrams.

2) SOC2/CAIQ: caiq-responses.xlsx and soc2-exhibit3.pdf are in the folder; SOC 2 exhibit is redacted to remove indiv employee identifiers.

3) HSM specifics: included a mapping file (HSM-instance-map.csv) that lists vendor, instance id, region tag and whether the device is multi-tenant or dedicated for the tenancy. We've redacted cryptographic material and device serials where disclosure could create ops risk; full serials are available under NDA/secure channel if required.

4) Operator access: operator-roster.csv includes role, last-privilege-elevation timestamp, and whether account is Redwood-managed. Per our policy, keystore operator privileges require JIT elevation via our PAM and are logged to an immutable audit store; we included a 30-day slice of that audit (audit-slice-202505) as a CSV in the folder.

5) VPC peering evidence: diagram + peering confirmation (peering id: pl-0a1b2c3d) and the peer subnet ranges in the packet. This confirms that the EU production slice uses a dedicated VPC peer for TerraHealth.

Next steps: I can (a) create a sealed zip with additional SOC 2 exhibit pages and the unredacted HSM device list for a TerraHealth security mailbox that signs an access agreement, or (b) schedule a short readout with your security team to walk the artifacts. We also included a proposed DPA amendment via DocuSign if you want a contractual binding statement about key locality for the EU tenant. DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/Envelope-ABC12345

Let me know which you prefer and we'll fast-track.
